children.text: Define the roles required for a Clinical AI Safety Committee.
Draft a 'Model Card' policy for vendor procurement.
Establish a 'Red Button' protocol for algorithm suspension.
Governance fails when it is purely IT-driven. Your committee must include clinical champions.
without a Chief Medical Information Officer (CMIO) and a Legal/Risk representative present.
Pro Tip: Invite a patient advocate to quarterly reviews. Their questions regarding data privacy often catch risks that technical teams miss.
Before deploying new tools, audit existing 'Silent AI'—algorithms embedded in your EHR (like Sepsis alerts) that may already be firing without oversight. Document their current False Positive rates.
Scenario: A vendor refuses to provide training data demographics citing 'IP protection.' Do you approve the pilot? (Answer: No. This violates the Transparency Standard defined in Step 1).

summary: Module 1: A step-by-step guide to establishing an algorithmic safety committee. We cover the charter, the stakeholders, and the initial audit framework.
title: Masterclass: Implementing AI Governance in Clinical Settings
